why: Amendment 1 priced cold time-to-action and sequential samples. P0-v2 measured the warm resident path. These predictions replace the expected counts used for P1. The earlier numbers stay on the earlier files.
comparison: Paired McNemar against A0, computed per seed. Report both seeds.
thinking_cap_derivation: floor of the GPU 4000 warm spare seconds times the GPU 4000 batch-1 decode tok/s. Median n_ctx on the ledger is in the 4000 band, so that cap is the one the arm uses.

A0.name: baseline_greedy
A0.derivation: A local_pass trajectory whose every local step has warm one-answer time at or below 10 s. Warm time is the P0-v2 turn-2 prefill plus (L-1)/decode_tok_s, with L from the ledger and the 4000 or 6000 band chosen by n_ctx.

A1.name: best_of_4_parallel
A1.derivation: For each trajectory, k is 4, else 2, else 1, else 0, the largest parallel sample count whose warm wall fits in 10 s on every local step. The expected count is the sum of 1-(1-14/200)^k. The median-only formula treats every trajectory as k=4 and is not the prediction. If the four samples collapse to the greedy call, the count falls to the A0 count.
A1.falsifier: Samples collapse to the greedy tool call, and the in-budget count falls to 14.

A2.name: retry_on_empty
A2.derivation: At the 4000 median, one greedy answer plus one cached resample fits in 10 s and a second resample does not. Empty trajectories are the closeout first_fail_EMPTY count. Each contributes the baseline rate on one extra sample.

A3.name: check_and_retry
A3.derivation: Same one-resample fit as A2. The class is closeout first_fail_EXEC_RESP.

A4.name: thinking_on
A4.decode: greedy, thinking enabled, max_new_tokens equal to the cap. The seed is recorded. Sampling is off.
A4.derivation: The cap is spent on every step. Count local_pass trajectories whose every step still finishes at or below 10 s. This is the in-budget ceiling under the full cap, not a model of answer quality. Quality can come out lower.

wall_s.A1_split_reason: One A1 seed over all 200 tasks does not fit in 7200 s, because best-of-4 has no streamer and runs to completion. The seed is two boots. McNemar uses the combined 200.

first_boot: A0 only. Its smoke still runs A0, A1, A2, A3, and A4.
